real: MiG-31BM Foxhound (R-37M long-range missiles, Kh-31P anti-radar missile)
shape: refs: none; the old builder (mb_p25_new): a MiG-31 look, big boxy intakes, a long straight fuselage, twin tails, four long R-37 missiles under the fuselage; 9.1 x 5.4 x 2.5 m (about 0.4 x the real aircraft); team bands on the fins; no real insignia.

features.feature: the long lofted fuselage (Team) with the radome, spine and dorsal fairing
the tandem two-seat canopy with its frames
big rectangular side intakes with splitter plates, ramps and dark ducts
the shoulder trapezoidal wing with root extensions, fences, wingtip lights
twin canted fins with rudders, all-moving tailplanes, two ventral fins
two large nozzles with petals and the afterburner glow
four R-37M under the fuselage on their recesses
wing pylons; the anti-radar missile on the right pylon on its own pivot (the free secondary)
flare dispensers on the rear fuselage sides (Mount_Flare_* from the wrapper)
the refuelling probe, pitot, blade antennas, lights, Team bands

budget.note: over the maximum is information only

wreck: the wrapper adds Part_wing (the left wing) for the breakup
